summary_claims.claim: Version of 23 May 2025 defined covered products including companion chatbots that can foreseeably attempt therapy or cause harmful attachment, and AI that generates social scores
The Governor said he would build on SB 243 with a bill the next year

note: Veto on 13 Oct 2025 is shown by the veto message and the Governor's list. Search found no reintroduced AB 1064; a Common Sense Media ballot initiative with similar language is reported only by secondary pages and is not an official instrument yet.
